gloss: to switch places; to be replaced

definitions.gloss: to switch places; to change places; to alternate
definitions.explanation: Two or more things or people swap positions or roles. Implies a mutual exchange where one goes out and another comes in.

definitions.gloss: to be replaced; to turn over; to be renewed
definitions.explanation: Members or contents of a group are gradually replaced by new ones over time.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}が{入|い}れ{替|か}わった。
{電車|でんしゃ}で{降|お}りる{人|ひと}と{乗|の}る{人|ひと}が{入|い}れ{替|か}わる。
examples.english: People getting off and people getting on the train switch places.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{心|こころ}と{体|からだ}が{入|い}れ{替|か}わるという{物語|ものがたり}だ。
examples.english: It's a story about two people whose minds and bodies switch.

examples.japanese: メンバーが{入|い}れ{替|か}わった。
{客|きゃく}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{入|い}れ{替|か}わる{人気|にんき}{店|てん}だ。
examples.english: It's a popular restaurant where customers constantly turn over.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}が{入|い}れ{替|か}わるたびに{新|あたら}しいメニューが{出|で}る。
examples.english: New menu items come out every time the seasons change.

notes:
An intransitive verb. The transitive counterpart is {入|い}れ{替|か}える (to replace, to swap). The compound {入|い}れ{替|か}わり{立|た}ち{替|か}わり means one after another, in constant succession.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・AとBが{入|い}れ{替|か}わる — A and B switch places
・{入|い}れ{替|か}わり{立|た}ち{替|か}わり — one after another; in succession
・メンバーが{入|い}れ{替|か}わる — the members are replaced
